breakdown.description: For a two-phase semicrystalline polymer, the measured density should lie between the amorphous and crystalline reference densities, but the setup gives a sample density higher than the crystalline density.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses a measured density of 1.22 g/cm³ instead of the erroneous 1.42 g/cm³ from the incomplete prompt. It explicitly confirms that 1.22 g/cm³ lies between the amorphous density (1.05 g/cm³) and the crystalline density (1.30 g/cm³), which is physically consistent for a two-phase semicrystalline polymer. This directly resolves the inconsistency where the sample density was incorrectly higher than the crystalline density.
